an10.44:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
an10.44:1.4: bhadanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.44:2.1: codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo
an10.44:2.3: codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:2.4: parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu khomhi, parisuddhenamhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena.
an10.44:2.5: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no ti.
an10.44:2.6: no ce bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti cattāro
an10.44:2.7: “iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū”ti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:3.2: “parisuddhavacīsamācāro nu khomhi” parisuddhenamhi vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena
an10.44:3.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu noti
an10.44:3.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhu parisuddha vacīsamācāro hoti, parisuddhena vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti cattāro,
an10.44:3.5: “iṅgha tāva āyasmā vācasikaṃ sikkhassū”ti. itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:4.2: “mettaṃ nu kho me cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ,
an10.44:4.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no”ti.
an10.44:4.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno mettaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ, tassa bhavanti cattāro,
an10.44:4.5: “iṅgha tāva āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu mettaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhapehī”ti. itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:5.2: “bahussuto nu khomhi sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā, majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti. tathārūpā me dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
an10.44:5.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhuno”ti.
an10.44:5.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. tassa bhavanti cattāro:
an10.44:5.5: “iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū”ti. itissa bhavanti vattāro,
an10.44:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.44:6.2: “ubhayāni nu kho me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti, suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.
an10.44:6.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo. udāhu no”ti.
an10.44:6.4: no ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno ubhayāni pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso. idaṃ panāyasmā “kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti iti puṭṭho na sampāyati,
an10.44:6.6: “iṅgha tāva āyasmā vinayaṃ sikkhassū”ti itissa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:7.8: codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā, ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabboti.
